FLUX.2 klein latents of structural-error generations
	

Latents, states and decoded images from 22 GPU sessions of one research package that studies how a text-to-image flow model produces structural errors: hands with an extra finger, kangaroos and horses with the wrong number of limbs, and a few objects (a cat tail, a stair railing, a ladder, headphones on a branch, a car door). Every image is a fixed seed under a fixed prompt.
